What Surge AI sells

  • RL Environments and Agents: Coding tasks for training and testing AI agents (software that takes actions to complete a task).
  • Rubrics and Verifiers: Grading rules and checks for model outputs.
  • RLHF: Human feedback for model training (people rate responses to guide model training).
  • SFT: Supervised fine-tuning (models learn from examples of desired responses).
  • Human Evaluation: Experts assess model responses and behavior.
  • Off-The-Shelf Data: Ready-made datasets for model training.
